10FAQs

Questions businesses ask us

More answers on our frequently asked questions page, or ask Harish directly.

Call 94459 78150

How much does website design cost in Chennai?

It depends on the number of pages, content, features and design work involved. After a short consultation we provide a written quote with a clear scope. Our guide to website design cost in Chennai explains the main factors.

How long does it take to build a website?

A focused business website typically takes a few weeks from approved plan to launch; larger or e-commerce sites take longer. We agree a timeline before starting.

Will my website be mobile friendly?

Yes. Every website we build is responsive, designed mobile-first and tested on phones, tablets and desktops.

Do you provide SEO after website development?

Yes. Every site launches with SEO foundations, and our SEO services and local SEO help you keep growing in Google.

Do you manage Google Ads?

Yes. We set up and manage Google Ads campaigns with conversion tracking, so you can see what each enquiry costs.

Can you maintain my website after launch?

Yes. Our website maintenance service covers updates, backups, security checks and content changes.
